endpoint.notes: CDP desktop_bridge. Promote into a Doubao/desktop adapter when one is registered; do not invent tool names from dsh-doubao-bridge.

auth.user_prompt: 桌面版已运行且 CDP 端口已监听时，通常不必再填密钥。

notes: Port 9225 is a declared hint, not the only default. If the CDP port moved, use from_process (loopback listen ports of the matched process). If a discovered port is already listening, leave the process alone (do not kill to 'fix' a probe). CDP /json/version is reachability, not chat_bridge=ok and not tool verification.

catalog.note: CDP /json/version and /json/list are browser targets, not a model catalog. Official 工作任务 names are filled from Doubao Work docs; this is inventory, not a live account list.
